instruction: Please help me profile the performance of all functions in the current python file and display execution time heatmap within VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible. Visualizing performance heatmaps of function execution times within VS Code requires specialized profiling extensions and cannot be verified through standard evaluator mechanisms. This is similar to the original task which requires visualizing numpy arrays - both need specific VS Code extensions that may not be installed or configured, and the visualization itself cannot be reliably captured or validated.
